description: Produce docs/architecture/P11_DELTA_NEUTRAL.md: full architecture for the LST-collateral / borrow-native / matched-perp-short delta-neutral loop. Must cover deposit flow, borrow venue adapters, perp hedge sizing math, rebalance cadence per funding epoch, and unwind triggers (basis negative, funding-rate flip). Done: reviewed markdown with component diagram, unwind sequence diagram, risk budget 0.35 rationale, and APR 9% target derivation.
title: Draft delta-neutral architecture spec

description: Define Solidity interfaces IDeltaNeutralVault, ILendingBorrowAdapter, IPerpHedgeAdapter plus the Python agent API schema (hedge sizing, rebalance, unwind calls) in onchain/src/p11/interfaces/ and src/sincor2/agents/p11_delta_neutral/api.py. Done: interfaces compile under solc 0.8.24, Python signatures are typed, and every external call site in the spec maps to exactly one interface function.
title: Define vault and adapter interfaces

description: Model the economics: LST staking APR vs perp funding cost spread, break-even basis calculation, 12 bps protocol fee routed to Treasury 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac, and TOA revenue projection at 25% max allocation. Done: a spreadsheet/model doc with fee accrual formulas, sensitivity table over funding-rate regimes, and a stated kill threshold where the strategy is uneconomic.
title: Model economics and 12 bps fee structure

description: Create the repo skeleton: onchain/src/p11/, src/sincor2/agents/p11_delta_neutral/, config/agents/, tests/pytest/test_p11_*.py stubs, scripts/deploy_p11.py stub, docs/ops/P11_RUNBOOK.md stub. Done: directories exist with stub READMEs, import paths resolve, and pytest collects the stub files with zero errors.
title: Create P11 repo layout

description: Fill the skeleton with compiling boilerplate: an empty DeltaNeutralVault.sol using ReentrancyGuard and SafeERC20, a Python agent skeleton with error handling and TOA hook stubs, and a config/agents/p11-delta-neutral.yaml stub with dry_run=true default. Done: forge/solc compiles the contracts under 0.8.24, the agent module imports cleanly, and CI picks up the new test files.
title: Write compiling boilerplate and stubs

description: Build the ERC-4626-style vault accepting LST deposits (wstETH/cbETH adapter pattern) with share accounting, deposit caps, ReentrancyGuard on all state-changing functions, SafeERC20 transfers, and non-bricking try/catch around external venue calls. Done: onchain/src/p11/DeltaNeutralVault.sol compiles under solc 0.8.24 and deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem round-trips hold share-price invariants in unit tests.
title: Build LST collateral vault contract

description: Implement the borrow adapter that borrows the native asset against vault LST collateral through a lending-venue interface (Morpho/Aave v3 pattern), enforcing an LTV ceiling and a health-factor floor that blocks borrows breaching it. Done: borrow/repay round-trip succeeds against a mocked venue, and any borrow pushing health factor below the floor reverts with a named error.
title: Build borrow adapter with LTV guards

description: Build the Python hedge engine in src/sincor2/agents/p11_delta_neutral/hedge_engine.py: opens exact notional-matched perp shorts via exchange SDK (Hyperliquid-style), enforces a +/-2% delta band, runs a reconciliation loop comparing on-chain collateral vs perp notional, and never touches treasury keys (live_blocked). Done: dry-run mode opens, sizes, and reconciles a full hedge cycle against a stub exchange with full error handling and structured logs.
title: Build perp hedge engine agent

description: Implement the funding-epoch rebalancer as a scheduler job: each epoch it reads the current funding rate, resizes the perp hedge to match collateral value drift, and tops up or withdraws LST collateral. Done: a dry-run log demonstrates one complete epoch cycle (read rate, compute delta, resize, rebalance) with idempotent re-runs.
title: Build funding-epoch rebalancer job

description: Implement the unwind circuit breaker: when basis turns negative or the funding rate flips sign (funding_flip_kill gate), the agent closes the perp short, repays the borrow, and exits LST collateral in a fixed ordered sequence that cannot leave debt unbacked. Done: a simulated funding flip triggers a full unwind to zero exposure, verified by post-unwind balance assertions.
title: Build basis-negative unwind circuit breaker

description: Route the 12 bps protocol fee to Treasury 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac on every harvest/rebalance settlement, with an on-chain fee accumulator and a pull-based claim to avoid bricking payouts. Done: fee math is unit-checked (fee = notional * 12 / 10000) and a harvest emits a FeeRouted event with the exact treasury address.
title: Route 12 bps fees to Treasury

description: Build the liquidation-threshold monitor: a lightweight agent watcher tracking health factor and the basis_sign gate, emitting alerts before any breach and forcing a rebalance-or-unwind decision. Done: dry-run alerts fire at the configured warning threshold with structured log lines consumable by the monitoring dashboard.
title: Build liquidation-threshold monitor

description: Write unit tests under tests/pytest/test_p11_units.py covering vault share math, borrow LTV/health-factor reverts, and fee accumulator math. Done: all tests pass, edge cases (zero deposit, dust amounts, max LTV boundary) are covered, and the suite runs in CI.
title: Write unit tests for vault and adapters

description: Write integration tests under tests/pytest/test_p11_integration.py exercising the full loop: deposit LST, borrow, open hedge, run one funding epoch, then trigger the unwind breaker. Done: end-to-end dry-run passes with balance assertions at each stage and no treasury key material touched.
title: Write integration tests for the full loop

description: Write invariant/fuzz tests (Foundry or hypothesis) asserting share-price monotonicity, health factor never below floor after any public call sequence, and fee accumulator never exceeding 12 bps of notional. Done: fuzz run completes the configured iteration count with zero invariant violations.
title: Write invariant and fuzz tests

description: Run a Base mainnet-fork simulation: fork at a pinned block, execute deposit/borrow/hedge against forked venue states, then simulate a funding-rate flip and verify the unwind breaker exits cleanly with debt fully repaid. Done: fork script in scripts/sim_p11_fork.py runs green with gas usage and PnL logged per stage.
title: Run Base fork simulation with flip scenario

description: Assemble the audit-prep package: frozen code hash, full natspec coverage, threat model doc (oracle manipulation, funding-rate griefing, venue insolvency), and a findings tracker. title: Assemble audit-prep package

title: Gas-optimize vault hot paths

description: Write technical documentation under docs/p11/: system overview, contract API reference, agent behavior spec, and the economic model summary. Done: docs build without warnings and every public function is documented with parameters and revert conditions.
